full_prompt_en: A square oil landscape shows a small group of mounted travelers crossing a shallow stream toward a distant city with gleaming golden domes. The sky is a wide pale blue-gray field across the upper third, thinly clouded and softly textured rather than intensely blue. Along the horizon, low ocher buildings and walls extend from side to side. Near the center-right, a cluster of large gold domes and slender vertical towers rises above the roofs, catching stronger sunlight than the surrounding masonry. A dark band of trees sits below the city and separates it from a broad patchwork of dry grass and green fields. In the middle ground, a narrow blue-green stream winds horizontally, then opens into a wider pool in the lower right. Its calm surface reflects muted teal and pale sky tones, with darker strokes marking the banks. A sunlit dirt track enters from the lower left and curves toward the right bank. Several small mounted figures travel along it near the center-left. Their garments and animals are indicated with compact, warm-colored touches; individual faces are too small to resolve. A pair of even smaller figures stands farther to the right near the field edge. Tufts of grass and low shrubs punctuate the ocher earth, growing thicker and greener beside the water. The painting retains short, varied brush marks in the foreground vegetation and water, while distant buildings are simplified into compact light-and-shadow blocks. Sunlight comes from high in the sky, warming the path, dry banks, and golden roofs, with shadows remaining gentle and brown rather than severe. The overall composition layers the cool stream, warm open plain, and pale city under a broad sky, giving the journey a spacious, calm sense of distance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画风景呈现一小队骑乘者越过浅溪，走向远处有闪亮金色圆顶的城市。上方三分之一是一片宽阔的浅蓝灰色天空，薄云轻覆，肌理柔和，并非浓烈蓝色。沿地平线，低矮赭黄色建筑与城墙从一侧延伸到另一侧。中央偏右，大型金色圆顶和细长竖塔从屋顶群中升起，比周围砖石接住更强的阳光。城市下方一道深色树林将其与宽阔而交错的干草地、绿田隔开。中景一条狭窄蓝绿色小溪水平弯转，在右下方展开成较宽水面。平静水面映着低饱和青绿和浅天空色，较深笔迹标明河岸。一条被阳光照亮的土路从左下进入，朝右岸弯去。几位小小骑乘者在中央偏左沿路前行。衣服和坐骑由紧凑暖色笔触点出，人物面孔太小，无法辨清。右侧田边还有两名更小的人影。草丛与低灌木点在赭黄色土地上，靠近水边时更浓、更绿。绘画在前景植被和水面保留短促多变笔迹，远方建筑则归纳为紧凑的明暗方块。日光从较高的天空照下，暖化道路、干燥河岸和金色屋顶，阴影仍柔和偏褐，并不严厉。整体构图把冷色水流、温暖开放的平原和淡色城市层层摆在宽阔天空下，使行进场景带有开敞而平静的远方感。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting combines a spacious panoramic arrangement with compact, carefully observed small marks. Pale blue-gray and muted teal cool the upper and lower fields, while ocher, sand, umber, and selective gold warm the central band. Distant detail is reduced to low horizontal masses and a few luminous high points; nearer surfaces carry short broken strokes that describe rough ground and gentle water. Darker clustered accents separate layers without outlining every form. The brushwork remains visible yet controlled, shifting from fine, dry texture in broad exposed areas to softer blended transitions farther away. High natural light spreads evenly across the composition and makes warm highlights glow rather than producing hard theatrical shadows. Receding horizontal zones, a curving diagonal, and a few small scale cues open depth across the frame. The overall effect is calm and sun-washed, with measured detail and restrained warm-cool contrast creating a sense of travel through open space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画把开敞的全景布局与紧凑、审慎观察的细小笔迹结合起来。浅蓝灰和低饱和青绿冷却上方与下方色域，赭黄、沙色、深棕及选择性的金色则暖化中央色带。远方细节归纳为低矮水平大块和少数发亮高点；较近表面由短促断续的笔触描出粗糙地面与轻柔水色。较深的聚集重音分开各层，却不为每个形体勾边。笔触可见而有节制，在广阔受光区域呈细而干的肌理，向远方转为较柔的混合过渡。高处自然光均匀铺满画面，让暖亮部发光，而不形成舞台式硬影。后退的水平分带、一条弯曲斜线和少量尺度线索共同打开画面纵深。整体效果平静而沐浴阳光，以有分寸的细节和克制冷暖对比创造穿行开阔空间的感受。
theme_en: Mounted travelers crossing a shallow stream toward a distant golden-domed city
theme_zh: 骑乘者越过浅溪，走向远处金色圆顶的城市
name: Edwin Lord Weeks
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
